response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior full-stack/web engineer with broad experience across many languages and frameworks, but the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements for this role: no Japanese language proficiency, no Linux kernel work, minimal recent C experience (last significant C/C++ work was in 2014-2015 for a desktop IDE, not embedded/UNIX systems), and no exposure to security technologies like MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, or L2/L3 switch networking. This is a fundamental mismatch with an embedded security firmware role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software development experience
Demonstrated systems-level programming ability (DLang, C++, low-latency async I/O)
Strong self-driven learner with open-source and teaching contributions
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement
No Linux kernel investigation/modification experience evident anywhere in work history
No background in embedded networking, switch hardware, or security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded systems experience
